purpose: Reproducible screening and explicit review dispositions. Raw machine notice hints remain unchanged; join this overlay by noticeId. Text screening is not visual parcel verification.

search.normalization: Unicode NFD accent removal, uppercase, collapse whitespace
search.logic: Both expressions must match on the same page. Also screen all 130 modern farmStructures title matches regardless of vineyard words.
limits: Keyword search is a discovery aid, not proof that every relevant notice was found. OCR errors, page-spanning wording and the five unresolved 2018 bulletins can hide notices.
Modern contents extraction covers selected DDT entries; legacy 2016 decisions and prefectural environmental notices may exist only in full page text.
No image review or parcel extraction is claimed for other agricultural notices or generic regulatory context.
No present-day farmer, producer entity match, cadastral succession or current geometry is verified by this dataset.
